title: Maximum Layer Count Quarter-Wave DBR with Free Thickness Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: A 24-layer TiO2/SiO2 quarter-wave stack initialized design, when thicknesses are freely optimized, will achieve higher visible reflectance and NIR transmittance than designs with fewer layers, because more interfaces provide greater spectral selectivity.
design_principle: Distributed Bragg reflector physics: alternating high/low index layers at quarter-wave optical thickness create constructive interference for reflection in the stopband. More pairs deepen and widen the stopband. At 45° incidence, the effective optical thickness shifts, requiring thickness compensation.
proposed_topology: Air | (TiO2 | SiO2) × 12 | Fused Silica Substrate - 24 layers total, starting with TiO2
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 24 layers
manufacturing_considerations: 24 layers is the maximum allowed per requirement
TiO2 and SiO2 are standard evaporatable/sputterable materials
thickness tolerance sensitivity should be evaluated
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Maximum number of interfaces for spectral discrimination
Literature precedent for VIS-NIR beam splitters using this approach
known_risks: 45° incidence causes polarization splitting between S and P states
Thick stacks may accumulate stress and adhesion issues
Optimizer may converge to local minima with 48 thickness variables
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer dielectric coating on fused silica substrate at 45° incidence. Stack sequence: TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao), TiO2 (Siefke), SiO2 (Gao) (24 layers total, starting with TiO2 (Siefke) adjacent to air). Materials: TiO2 (Siefke) and SiO2 (Gao) from catalogue. Substrate: SiO2 (Gao) (fused silica). Incident medium: air. Wavelength bands: 450-650 nm (target high reflectance), 700-1000 nm (target high transmittance). Angle: 45 degrees. Design variables: all 24 layer thicknesses in nanometers. Initialize thicknesses near quarter-wave optical thickness at 675 nm center wavelength, then optimize all thicknesses to maximize the composite objective. Maximum 24 layers constraint is satisfied exactly.
